International Impact Book Awards winner David Wilson was born on Halloween in Bangor, Maine in the late 1960s. David became heavily involved in art during his childhood years and continued the hobby into adulthood.

...

David lives in Central Maine with his wife, dog, and two cats. He still enjoys the outdoor activities and his artwork.
